title: La investidura y el control parlamentario al Gobierno
goal: Comprender la sesión de investidura en el Congreso, la cuestión de confianza y la moción de censura constructiva.

items: State that the Congress of Deputies invests the Prime Minister (Article 99).
Distinguish the absolute majority required in the first investiture vote (176 seats) from the simple majority 48 hours later.
Explain the difference between a question of confidence and a constructive motion of no confidence.
Use 'en caso de que + subjunctive' for constitutional contingencies.
I can state that the Congress of Deputies invests the Prime Minister (Article 99).
I can distinguish the absolute majority required in the first investiture vote (176 seats) from the simple majority 48 hours later.
I can explain the difference between a question of confidence and a constructive motion of no confidence.
I can use 'en caso de que + subjunctive' for constitutional contingencies.
